description:
Grand Blood Donation Camp at Mulund Railway Station

A grand blood donation camp was successfully organised at Mulund Railway Station in association with JJ Hospital, with the active participation of 10 Rotary Clubs and 3 Rotaract Clubs from Mulund and Bhandup. Participating clubs are RC Mulund Hill View, RC Bhandup, RC Mulund, RC Hills, RC Valley, RC Oberoi, RC Mulund East, RC Mulund Greens, Retract Club of Mumbai Mulund South, Rotaract Club of Bhandup

The camp was inaugurated by IPDG Rtn. Manish Motwani, marking a significant initiative towards community health and social service.

As part of the camp, 50 individuals came forward for blood count testing, of which 16 were deferred due to medical conditions.

The initiative reflected the spirit of Rotary’s commitment to community welfare, preventive healthcare, and collaborative service, bringing together Rotary and Rotaract members to make a meaningful difference.
